name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands 'Take the key' unconditionally and with no preference cue, so has_door_key is a required goal, but no clause makes it happen; the soft Existence(target_picked_up) also misreads 'try to pick up the box' — 'try to' only marks preference when scoped as such, but here the pickup is the mission's target. Add a hard Existence(has_door_key) to force taking the key, and keep Existence(door_open) with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open); target_picked_up may stay soft as a preference ('try to').

CHANGES REQUIRED: Redundant Existence(has_door_key) is a defect. The task commands three chained steps; the hard Existence(door_open) with hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) already forces has_door_key, so the extra hard Existence adds a redundant goal. Remove Existence(has_door_key); keep Existence(door_open), Precedence(has_door_key, door_open), and the soft Existence(target_picked_up).

texts: The door is opened only after the key has been acquired.
Preferably, the target box is picked up.
